# `aitbc developer list`

List registered developers with optional active-only, limit, and offset filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc developer list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--active-only`, `--all` | flag | `true` | no | List only active developers |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Maximum number of developers |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Offset for pagination |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc developer list
```
